subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, I hope this email finds you well. We are excited to announce that our company will be hosting a team building event next month. The event will include various activities aimed at fostering teamwork and collaboration among us. More details regarding the event schedule and location will be shared soon. Please mark your calendars and stay tuned for further updates. We look forward to seeing you all there! Best regards, [Your Name]
